text:
maria: Hey team — planning a new GPU nodepool for inference-runners. Proposal: reserved capacity for baseline with p4d.24xlarge (for steady throughput) + a small g4dn.xlarge spot pool for bursty dev jobs. Need input on Terraform capacity reservation wiring, kube taints, and spot fallback handling. Any red flags?

akshay: baseline throughput target? how many concurrent model streams are we sizing for?
maria: target is ~600 token/s steady across 10 pods (low concurrency per pod). want <120ms p99 gen latency. So reserved for the p4d baseline, spots only for background batch/CI.
jules: Sounds fine. For AWS I'd add an explicit capacity reservation resource and pin lifecycle to avoid accidental destroy. Example snippet:```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_capacity_reservation" "gpu_baseline" {
  instance_type         = "p4d.24xlarge"
  availability_zone     = "us-west-2a"
  instance_platform     = "Linux/UNIX"
  instance_count        = 2
  tags = {
    Name = "redwood-gpu-baseline"
  }
}

resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu_base_lt" {
  name_prefix   = "gpu-base-"
  image_id      = var.ami_gpu
  instance_type = "p4d.24xlarge"
  lifecycle {
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
  # user_data, iam, etc.
}
```
jules: And make sure the ASG/managed node group references the launch template and the capacity reservation scope; if using kOps/EKS managed node group we do the reservation on the AZ and then pin by AZ/instance type.
maria: For k8s-level handling: plan to taint the reserved nodes so only inference pods schedule there. Then allow spots to catch anything else. Thoughts on taint key/value?
akshay: use taint `dedicated=inference:NoSchedule` and nodeSelector/affinity on the inference DaemonSet/Deployment. autoscaler should be configured to prefer removing spot nodes first.

akshay: Also add https://github.com/aws/aws-node-termination-handler to spot pool with lifecycle handler and cordon+drain hooks.
maria: Good call. Any concerns around driver/container image pulls — we need ECR/NVIDIA registry auth on nodes for the driver installer.
nate: For ECR/ECS: use IRSA and then create a k8s imagePullSecret in the inference namespace during bootstrap. Example: `kubectl create secret docker-registry regcred --docker-server=public.ecr.aws --docker-username=AWS --docker-password=$(aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2) --namespace inference`

sam: ping @jules for a quick review when you open the TF PR, especially for the `prevent_destroy` and AZ pinning.
jules: happy to review. Also recommend adding an autoscaler expander config and a node group-scalingPolicy that keeps at least 1 reserved p4d up per AZ.

infra-bot: terraform plan success on branch `feature/gpu-resv` — 3 to add, 0 to change, 0 to destroy. (mock run) :rocket:
maria: I'll open the PR in ~2 hours and include the snippets above + k8s taint/affinity docs and the node-termination-handler manifest. Thanks all :thumbsup:
